global_disclaimer: Every entry is a named, reproducible engineering assumption. None is a measured vintage BLD value and none identifies the fitted manufacturer, selection criterion, tolerance, aging, or parasitics.

taper_coordinate.x_0: declared counter-clockwise endpoint when viewed from the shaft
taper_coordinate.x_1: declared clockwise endpoint when viewed from the shaft
taper_coordinate.f: normalized resistance fraction from physical terminal 1 to wiper terminal 2
taper_coordinate.contact_residuals: zero in these provisional laws; introduce only through a separately named sensitivity or measured profile
taper_coordinate.physical_orientation_warning: P-SM does not number CW/CCW ends and page-4 artwork is mirrored; assumptions A-P1 through A-P5 own orientation.

TAPER-LIN-IDEAL-V1.limitations: ideal law; no residual, wiper/contact resistance, detent, tolerance or vintage curve

evidence: generic engineering convention: 10 percent of track at midpoint
TAPER-LOG-10PCT-MID-V1.limitations: 10 percent midpoint is not documented by TC or measured on a vintage part

evidence: mirror of named generic 10-percent LOG law
TAPER-NEGLOG-10PCT-MID-V1.limitations: reverse law and physical endpoint sense are provisional, not TC documentation

P2.function: Bass in coupled active tone network

P3.function: Treble in coupled active tone network

OPAMP-4741-FAMILY-GENERIC-V1.scope: family-generic quad 741-like op amp; selected for IC1 only
not_claimed: single-supply performance at the BLD operating point

supply_span.condition: family data commonly states +/-2 to +/-20 V; system safety remains limited by other parts

open_loop_gain_typical.condition: +/-15 V family typical; grade/vendor spread applies

input_voltage_noise_density_typical.condition: at 1 kHz, published family typical; frequency-dependent model not frozen

output_resistance_typical.condition: open-loop family typical, not closed-loop output impedance

output_current_typical.condition: family typical; do not treat as a guaranteed symmetric hard limiter

OPAMP-4741-FAMILY-GENERIC-V1.m1_model_rule: M1 must record how these conditional dual-supply typicals are mapped to the BLD single-supply rails; no undocumented rail-relative swing scaling is frozen here.

OPAMP-IDEAL-SENSITIVITY-V1.scope: topology-only M1 sensitivity comparison; never the documentary device selection
OPAMP-IDEAL-SENSITIVITY-V1.pinout: same standard quad pinout as OPAMP-4741-FAMILY-GENERIC-V1
OPAMP-IDEAL-SENSITIVITY-V1.limitations: not a 4741, not a vintage claim, and cannot predict overload, noise, bias, slew or headroom

JFET-BF245A-DOCUMENTARY-STATIC-V1.scope: provisional switch-state envelope for Q1/Q2; not a transistor-fit model

dynamic_suppressor_controlled.purpose: later M1 variant; not first-oracle runnable until a device equation is selected

evidence: P-SM identifies BF245-A and the switching/control topology
numerical R/C values are deliberately generic engineering assumptions
JFET-BF245A-DOCUMENTARY-STATIC-V1.limitations: not a BF245 transfer curve, not TC Q2 selection, not a vintage measurement; M1 must sensitivity-sweep or replace it

SUPPLY-9V-EFFECTIVE-V1.interpretation: post-protection effective rail for first oracle; external D1/jack/POR path remains documented but is outside the reduced supply source
SUPPLY-9V-EFFECTIVE-V1.vref_rule: solve R2/R3/C1 explicitly; never clamp VREF to 4.5 V
evidence: P-SM single-supply topology and 9 V battery context
SUPPLY-9V-EFFECTIVE-V1.limitations: no sag, ripple, protection drop or battery impedance

SUPPLY-9V-ADAPTER-DIRECT-V1.interpretation: adapter applies directly to the VPLUS/0 power-jack contacts; both battery normalling contacts are open and D1 reverse-isolates BAT+
SUPPLY-9V-ADAPTER-DIRECT-V1.limitations: adapter source resistance/ripple and connector contact resistance are not documented

SUPPLY-9V-BATTERY-SWITCHED-V1.interpretation: battery path with A-to-VPLUS power-jack normalling and input ring-to-sleeve return closure
SUPPLY-9V-BATTERY-SWITCHED-V1.limitations: battery/contact resistance, state of charge and exact jack mechanics are not measured

SUPPLY-18V-EFFECTIVE-SENSITIVITY-V1.limitations: target-unit capacitor/IC2/device ratings must be verified before hardware use

INPUT-BOUNDARY-SERVICE-INTERNAL-V1.interpretation: No extra input-impedance element; service R13=1 MOhm remains the internal bias/load fact.
INPUT-BOUNDARY-SERVICE-INTERNAL-V1.limitations: does not assert the whole complex input impedance equals exactly 1 MOhm

INPUT-BOUNDARY-MANUAL-SENSITIVITY-V1.interpretation: manual-claim comparison target upstream of the frozen service circuit; never mutates or parallels R13
INPUT-BOUNDARY-MANUAL-SENSITIVITY-V1.limitations: manual measurement definition, state and frequency are absent

BOUNDARY-STUDIO-GENERIC-V1.limitations: not a TC test condition, pickup/cable model, or measured vintage load

evidence: generic sensitivity condition; 4741 family data include 10 kOhm swing tests
